title: Solabia appoints Muriel Koch as President and Chief Executive Officer
summary: Solabia Group, a leading international supplier of ingredients for the cosmetics, nutrition and life sciences markets, announces that Muriel Koch has taken up her position as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective 29 October 2026
